title: Rabbi Tzadok ben Chaluka
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Yoma 78a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.78a.11-13) Rabbah bar bar Chana said: “They asked Rabbi Elazar (ben Pedat)… Rabbi Tzadok ben Chaluka stood on his feet and said: I saw Rabbi Yose ben Zimra, who was old and sat in the academy,” etc.

Hyman infers from this that he belonged to the generation after Rabbi, for Rabbi Yose ben Zimra was related by marriage to Rabbi. Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Yitzchak ben Chaluka, and Hyman likewise notes that Yuchasin did not cite Rabbi Tzadok ben Chaluka.

notes.text: The linked Gemara begins with Rav Menashya bar Tachlifa transmitting from Rav Amram, who transmits from Rabbah bar bar Chana. It then names Rabbi Tzadok ben Chakula. He describes Rabbi Yose ben Zimra in the first account, which Rabbi Abba disputes. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3020&lang=en) gives both versions. Hyman spells Chaluka and reports the Yitzchak variant and the Yuchasin omission.
